queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__ecw_comparison_info ( product_id MEDIUMINT(8) unsigned NOT NULL, compared_product_id MEDIUMINT(8) unsigned NOT NULL, count MEDIUMINT(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, list_id MEDIUMINT(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, group_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (product_id, compared_product_id, list_id, group_by), INDEX (count), INDEX (group_by) ) DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__ecw_comparison_pages ( page_id MEDIUMINT(8) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, product_ids MEDIUMTEXT, category_ids MEDIUMTEXT, status CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', storefront_id MEDIUMINT(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, timestamp INT(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (page_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__ecw_comparison_page_descriptions ( page_id MEDIUMINT(8) unsigned NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', short_description MEDIUMTEXT, description MEDIUMTEXT, page_title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', meta_description VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', meta_keywords VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', lang_code CHAR(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (page_id, lang_code), FOREIGN KEY (page_id) REFERENCES ?:ab__ecw_comparison_pages (page_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;
REPLACE INTO ?:privileges (privilege, is_default, section_id, group_id, is_view) VALUES ('ab__ecw.data.manage', 'Y', 'ab__addons', 'ab__extended_comparison_wishlist', 'N')
